name: shell-glob
description: TypeScript port of zsh's globbing and pattern matching.

scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
scripts.fixtures: ZSH=./zsh/Src/zsh && $ZSH -f ./scripts/gen-zsh-cases.zsh > test/fixtures/zsh-cases.txt && node scripts/extract-ztst.mjs && node scripts/harvest-patterns.mjs > /tmp/zg-patterns.zsh && $ZSH -f /tmp/zg-patterns.zsh > /tmp/zg-raw-patterns.txt && node scripts/compress-sweep.mjs /tmp/zg-raw-patterns.txt > test/fixtures/harvested.txt && node scripts/harvest-globs.mjs > /tmp/zg-globs.zsh && $ZSH -f /tmp/zg-globs.zsh > /tmp/zg-raw-globs.txt && node scripts/compress-globs.mjs /tmp/zg-raw-globs.txt > test/fixtures/harvested-globs.txt && node scripts/harvest-approx.mjs > /tmp/zg-approx.zsh && $ZSH -f /tmp/zg-approx.zsh > /tmp/zg-approx-out.txt && node scripts/write-approx.mjs /tmp/zg-approx-out.txt && node scripts/harvest-braces.mjs > /tmp/zg-braces.zsh && $ZSH -f /tmp/zg-braces.zsh > /tmp/zg-braces-out.txt && node scripts/compress-braces.mjs /tmp/zg-braces-out.txt > test/fixtures/braces.txt
